capabilities: Render a group of image embeds as a horizontal scrolling strip of fixed height
Add images by uploading files, pasting from the clipboard, or fuzzy-searching the vault
Reorder, copy, remove and enlarge images by drag, buttons, or a full-screen viewer
Keep gallery images indexed in a note property so backlinks and Bases formulas see them
Rename added images after the note and rewrite gallery lines when images are moved
extras: Documents known limits: PDF export wraps instead of scrolling, adding and editing are disabled inside hover previews, and disabling the plugin leaves plain code blocks.
problem: A group of image embeds in a note stacks vertically, so several screenshots swallow many screens of scrolling.

relations.evidence: Rename plugins such as Paste image rename usually do this, but they wait for a link in the note body

summary: Image gallery block that renders a group of images as one horizontal scrolling strip, with upload, paste, drag to reorder and a full-screen viewer.
